author: Christa Schafer
text: What a smooth experience! Having a septic system is new to me. I did some research prior and JC Septic was referred to me by my friends. I am glad I had them come out to pump the tank. Everything looked good and we discussed details throughout the process. They were very professional, patient, kind, and knowledgeable. I highly recommend JC Septic to maintain your pump outs/maintenance needs. I will definitely use them again. Thank you, JC!

author: Kathy Turnell
text:
Huge shout out to JC Septic! Their response time was incredibly fast, and the crew was outstanding—professional, knowledgeable, and most importantly, honest and straightforward.

They diagnosed and fixed the problem on the first visit, unlike another company that made multiple trips (four), wasted my time, and overcharged me—$1,100 each time they claimed to “fix” the issue—yet never actually resolved it.

JC Septic’s pricing was more than fair, and the quality of their work speaks for itself. I highly recommend them—10/10!

author: Fred Garrity
text: This was absolutely a great emergency service. We had our plumbers check our system found a full tank. Our office manager called at 1702 on Friday Evening they came and were done by 1815 on Friday. Cant say enough good things about the owners of this business. Father Son team working a great business for the Eastern Shore of MD and DE.

author: Melanie White
text: JC Septic did a great job! Easy to reach, came the next day for a routine pump out. Fast and efficient and very affordable! I would highly recommend them for any of your septic needs.

author: Joe Gilmore
text: Believe the 5.0 rating. They were here within 45 minutes! Pumped and gave me pointers on cleaning filter, etc. I'm a very happy customer and highly recommend them.
